date_basis: owner conversation; original report has no timestamp

redactions.results[].command: matching temporary source/SDK/probe path prefixes replaced only

unchanged_fields: source Git SHA, dirty flag, SDK digest/count, compiler identity, per-source hashes, argv flags, result statuses, exit codes, stdout/stderr and summary

additional_terminal_observations.source: owner-provided terminal transcript, not the compiler JSON

not_established: fresh compile of future source commits
publication: prepared supplement; no GitHub source commit, tag or release created by preparation

earlier_failed_report.note: Retained as preceding failure, not rewritten as PASS; not included in public supplement.
